title: Session page: the Tasks tab is now a table with filters

owner_note.text: A session's Tasks tab now shows every task as one sortable table (state, task, day, kind, session, cost), newest first, with a Filters ▾ menu for state, day and kind, so a four-day session can be read one day at a time. The old nested list, with its Approve buttons, is one tap away under "Nested". Task records have no "kind", so it is derived: project, agent task or plain task. On a phone the table scrolls sideways inside its own box and the page stays put; checked live at 390 (135 tasks, 0 errors).
